title: [ROCm][Perf] MXFP8 K-loop mask and activation sharing for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on gfx950
body:
## Purpose

Two fixes to `RocmDotScaledMxfp8LinearKernel` for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on AMD gfx950 (MI355X).

**1. K-loop mask (`EVEN_K` constexpr)**
The Triton `tl.dot_scaled` K-loop was unmasked, so `apply_weights` guarded with `K % 128 == 0` and dequantized the full weight to BF16 on every forward pass for shapes where `K % 32 == 0` but `K % 128 != 0`. Adding `EVEN_K: tl.constexpr` to predicate the tail mask relaxes the guard from `% 128` to `% 32`.
